title: Astrocraft - Nether Planets
description: A resource pack designed to add custom textures to Nether Planets using Astrocraft
body:
This is a resource pack designed for the mod [Astrocraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/astrocraft). and is meant to be a continuation of my Resource Pack [Astrocraft - Custom Planets](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/astrocraft-custom-planets). This resource pack will not work without Astrocraft.

The Nether had been stated numorous times to not be underneath the overworld. This interpretation has lead some to believe that the Nether is another planet within the Minecraft Solar System. And while that belief is also wrong, some wish to still headcannon this reality anyways. This Resource Pack is designed for those people.

# **IMPORTANT**
In order for this resource pack to work, you must go into the mod's config menu:

![Config Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a162fe7f61f4be0f731550b15d94af941274265.png)

Once here, you must change the "Model/Texture" option to one of four possibilities I've provided you.

## Nether Biomes
This option is for people who want their Nether planet to show its biomes on the surface.

![Nether Biomes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/277ef996dbbcf4c1c02733010a927e30183fc349.png)

## Nether Bedrock
This option is for people who believe that the Bedrock Ceiling is the surface of the planet, giving it a grey noisy surface.

![Nether Bedrock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfdf2f7ce83999f72a306f678dc479bec4fea629.png)

## Nether Clouds
This option is for people who believe that the Nether has a thick, Venus-like atmosphere that obscures the surface of the Planet.

![Nether Clouds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fd2b328b6c8ed314fb16ca858a531a912384cb8.png)

## Nether Gas Giant
This option is for people who believe that the Nether is a compressed, dense core of a Gas Giant planet.

![Nether Gasgiant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b351e24d86d98d26765ef4de7ae1b853487e916.png)
